key_insight: ME-GNN improves fluid prediction in complex geometries by combining local graph message passing with multi-scale feature extraction from grid-based attention U-Net features.
engineering_relevance: The method targets faster, more accurate surrogate modeling for expensive CFD workflows in automotive and aerospace design on large, irregular meshes.
method: Two-step GNN message passing to capture detailed local flow interactions.
Attention U-Net on uniform grids to extract both fine and coarse spatial features.
K-hop subgraph sampling for scalable training on large meshes while preserving locality.
evidence_signal: The model reports strong benchmark performance across ShapeNet-Car, AirfRANS, and DrivAerNet, including relative L2 errors of 0.0196 for velocity and 0.0556 for surface pressure on ShapeNet-Car.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful subgraph sampling and grid/mesh alignment, which can be challenging for very large or highly irregular geometries.
paper_title: A multi-scale feature enhanced graph neural network for fluid dynamics prediction in complex geometries
